description: Sony revealed a host of new first-party games at State of Play, along with several third-party announcements. God of War Laufey and Until Dawn 2 were revealed, while Wolverine got another gameplay trailer. Ubisoft revealed Rayman Legends Retold, a remake of the 2D platformer. Here's everything that was announced at State of Play.
title: Everything Announced at State of Play: God of War Laufey, Until Dawn 2, Rayman Legends Retold

description: Vivo X500 Pro Max is tipped to come with a 6.85-inch LIPO flat BOE display with narrow bezels. The display is said to offer a 144Hz refresh rate and 2K resolution. The handset is said to be in the testing phase in China. It could come with a 50-megapixel primary camera with a Sony LYT-838 1/1.28-inch sensor. It could run on a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Display and Battery Details Surface Online in Early Leak; Largest Model Said to Feature 6.85-Inch Screen

description: Android phones are now capable of detecting fake calls to alert users even before they pick up a call, Google announced on Tuesday. The Mountain View-based tech giant, in a blog post, said that the new fake call detection functionality is now rolling out globally for devices running Android 12 and newer versions. The new security feature, which will act as an additional layer of protection against bad actors, is claimed to curb the problem of AI-based voice cloning scams, call spoofing attacks, and impersonation fraud.
title: Google Introduces Fake Call Detection for Android Phones to Curb Call Spoofing Attacks

description: The UK Financial Conduct Authority has warned football clubs that sponsorship deals with unauthorised crypto firms could expose them to legal, financial, and reputational risks. The regulator has called for stronger due diligence on commercial partners.
title: UK's FCA Warns Premier League Clubs Over Unauthorised Crypto Sponsor Risks

description: Samsung is planning to launch the Samsung Galaxy A27, and the last several weeks have been full of rumours. Now the phone has passed through the US FCC and should be ready to launch soon. The FCC listing shows the Samsung Galaxy A27 with the model numbers SM-A276B and SM-A276U. The Galaxy A27 is expected to come with a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset and a 6.7-Inch display. It could pack a triple rear camera unit including a 50-megapixel main sensor.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 Reportedly Bags US FCC Certification Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: The New York State Department of Financial Services and the European Banking Authority have signed an MoU to coordinate supervision of cross-border stablecoin activities. The agreement aims to share information, monitor risks, and conduct market surveillance under MiCA.
title: NYDFS, European Banking Authority Join Forces to Oversee, Monitor Stablecoin Activities

description: Google on Wednesday began rolling out Gemini thinking levels across platforms, including Gemini's iOS and Android apps, Google’s Vice President of Gemini and AI Studio, Josh Woodward, announced in a post on X. The new thinking modes are available for the Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Gemini 3.1 Pro models. The three Gemini models have two thinking levels as standard. The new “Extended Thinking” mode, according to Google, is best suited for “complex problem solving”.
title: Google Rolls Out Gemini Thinking Levels Across Platforms With 'Extended' Thinking Mode for All Users

description: Bitcoin slipped near $67,000 as institutional demand weakened amid sustained ETF outflows and renewed concerns over Mt. Gox-linked Bitcoin movements. Analysts said heavy liquidations, cautious investor sentiment, and macroeconomic uncertainty continue to weigh on crypto markets, while traders closely watch key support and resistance levels for signs of stabilisation.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $67,000 as ETF Outflows, Institutional Selling Intensify

description: Lumio Vision 9 (2026) and Vision 7 (2026) have been launched in India in a new 55-inch display size, the tech firm announced on Wednesday. This comes weeks after the two smart TVs were unveiled in India on April 16. The Lumio Vision 9 (2026) is powered by a MediaTek Pentonic 700 SoC, along with 3GB of DDR4 RAM and 64GB of onboard storage. It sports a QD-Mini LED display, offering up to 800 nits peak brightness, 82 percent colour coverage, up to 144Hz of refresh rate with native 4K resolution, and up to 240Hz of refresh rate with 1080p resolution, along with VRR, ALLM, and QMS support.
title: Lumio Introduces 55-Inch Variants of Vision 9 (2026) and Vision 7 (2026) Smart TVs in India: Price, Features

description: Nvidia announced RTX Spark at Computex 2026, calling it a superchip that can deliver workstation-grade AI capabilities in thin-and-light laptops. At the annual computer expo, Nvidia highlighted the platform’s ability to run large language models locally, potentially delivering up to 1 petaflop of AI compute. While the chipmaker did not disclose its pricing, analysts have offered an early indication of how much consumers may have to shell out for RTX Spark-powered machines.
title: RTX Spark Laptops Said to Cost More Than Traditional AI PCs; Base Models Could Start at $1,799

description: Realme P4R 5G will be launched in India on June 10, the smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. The new Realme phone will go on sale in India via Flipkart in three colour options, namely Lavender Glare, Silver Glare, and Titanium Glare. Along with this, the smartphone maker has revealed various specifications and features of the upcoming handset. The Realme P4R 5G is confirmed to be powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, paired with an 8,000mAh battery. The handset will support 45W wired fast charging.
title: Realme P4R 5G India Launch Date Revealed Along With Design and Key Specifications

description: Insomniac Games revealed a new gameplay trailer for Marvel's Wolverine at Sony's State of Play broadcast on Tuesday. The developer also announced pre-order details for the superhero action-adventure game. Marvel's Wolverine can now be pre-ordered on PlayStation Store.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Gets Visceral Gameplay Trailer at State of Play, Pre-Orders Now Live

description: A tipster has dropped new details on the Xiaomi 18 series launch timeline and specifications. The lineup is said to go official in September. The vanilla Xiaomi 18 is tipped to feature a  6.4-inch display with 2K resolution. The Pro models are said to come with silicon battery units and dual 200-megapixel cameras.
title: Xiaomi 18 Tipped to Sport 6.4-Inch Display; Pro Models Said to Feature Dual 200-Megapixel Rear Cameras

description: Meta is said to be testing a new feature that would make it easier for users to follow multi-part videos. The feature, called Series, is reportedly geared towards Instagram and Facebook Reels viewers. According to a report, it may allow creators to group related Reels into a dedicated collection, enabling viewers to watch episodes in sequence and keep track of ongoing content. The feature is currently said to be in testing with a limited number of creators.
title: Meta Reportedly Testing ‘Series’ Feature to Organise Instagram, Facebook Reels Into Episodic Collections

description: Lava Bold N2 5G was launched in India with a 6,000mAh battery unit. It has a 6.75-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate and an IP64-rated dust and water-resistant build. The Lava Bold N2 5G runs on an octa-core Unisoc T8200 processor paired with 4GB RAM and 64GB storage. It has a 13-megapixel dual rear camera unit and a 6,000mAh battery. It is released in two colour options.
title: Lava Bold N2 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 6.75-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: Honor X7e has been launched in select global markets. The new smartphone packs a 7,500mAh battery with support for 45W wired fast charging. The handset is powered by an octa core MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra chipset, paired with an ARM Mali G52 MC2 GPU. The new dual SIM smartphone ships with Honor’s Android 16-based MagicOS 10. It sports a 6.61-inch HD+ TFT LCD screen, offering up to 120Hz of refresh rate and up to 1,010 nits peak brightness. The Honor X7e will go on sale globally via the Honor online store in Midnight Black and Sunrise Orange colour options.
title: Honor X7e Launched With 7,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Motorola Edge 2026 launched in the US and Canada. It comes with a 6.3-inch AMOLED display and runs on the MediaTek Dimensity 7450 SoC. It has a triple rear camera setup, led by a 50-megapixel main sensor. The phone carries a 5,000mAh battery with both wired and wireless charging support. It has IP68 + IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance.
title: Motorola Edge 2026 Launched With 6.3-Inch Display, MediaTek Dimensity 7450 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: WhatsApp is said to be developing a new privacy-focused feature for Android aimed at helping users identify potential scams prior to engaging with them. According to a feature tracker, it will analyse incoming messages from unknown senders and flag suspicious conversations to protect users against fraudulent activity. The in-development feature, dubbed Scam Alert, reportedly works entirely on-device and is said to maintain the same end-to-end encryption as traditional WhatsApp conversations.
title: WhatsApp Said to Be Developing On-Device Scam Detection Feature for Android
motorola razr fold Is Built for People Who Expect More From Foldables

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra reportedly surfaced on the Bluetooth SIG website with model number SM-F976. The listing confirms the model number and moniker of the phone. Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra is tipped to offer a 5,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging support. The overall dimensions, display sizes, and general design of the new foldable are said to remain identical to the Galaxy Z Fold 7. The new phone is said to measure 4.1mm thick in the unfolded state and could weigh 215g.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Spotted on Bluetooth SIG Database; New Leak Hints at Battery, Charging Upgrades

description: Redmi Turbo 5 will be launched in India on June 16, a leaked promotional poster suggests. The leaked promotional poster also shows the Redmi Turbo 5 in a white colour option, which could be offered in addition to the already confirmed black shade. Contrary to the latest leak, a report recently highlighted that the smartphone will be unveiled in the country on June 18. This comes weeks after the company began teasing the launch of the Redmi Turbo 5 in India. A dedicated microsite for the handset was recently made live on Amazon, confirming its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 India Launch Date Spotted in Leaked Promotional Image: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Sony and Santa Monica have finally revealed the next God of War game. At State of Play, the developer showed 20 minutes of gameplay for God of War Laufey, the next mainline game in the series. The game will follow Faye's journey in to the afterlife, battling gods and creatures from different mythologies. God of War Laufey will release on PS5 soon.
title: God of War Laufey Revealed With Extended Gameplay Trailer Showcasing New Protagonist, Setting and Combat System

description: Apple announced the list of winners and finalists of the 2026 Apple Design Awards across several app and game categories.on Tuesday. The Cupertino-based tech giant recognised 12 apps and games and commemorated their developers for bringing innovation and technical advancements to their apps across Apple devices like iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Presented each year since 1996, the 2026 edition saw grug win in the Delight and Fun category, while Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition was recognised in the Best Visual and Graphics category.
title: Apple Design Awards 2026 Winners Announced: Guitar Wiz, NBA, Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition Bag Top Spots

description: Anthropic on Tuesday announced the expansion of its advanced cybersecurity-focused AI model, Claude Mythos Preview, through its Project Glasswing initiative. The San Francisco-based AI startup said that about 150 new organisations across more than 15 countries will now have access to the model. At launch, it was limited to roughly 50 partners. India, notably, is among the countries selected for the expansion, alongside Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Japan, and South Korea.
title: Anthropic Expands Project Glasswing to 15 Countries, Brings Claude Mythos to India
